mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the eccentric driver was most worthwhile: its off-centre peg explains how rotation can repeatedly disturb the cord.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to mount the motor before fitting the posts was the least worthwhile moment; the required order was not clear beforehand.

surprise.text: The disturbance reflected from the far end of the cord, rather than simply stopping there.

arbitrary.text: Having to fit the cord posts before the cradled motor felt somewhat arbitrary; I did not see why that order was necessary.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what else the motor-driven wave machine can demonstrate, especially after seeing the reflected disturbance.
